title: Kirby Q2 2026 — Industry Signals from Marine, Power, Repair & Oilfield Markets
standfirst: Kirby's July 29 print can show where scarce equipment earns more — and where high utilization fails to lift rates.
meta_description: What Kirby's Q2 2026 report can reveal about pricing, utilization, and usable capacity across marine and industrial equipment markets.
ledger_finding: Inland tank-barge utilization has held between 90 and 94 percent for seven quarters; the Q2 print tests whether rate still follows it.

sections.html: Read Kirby's July 29 report for one relationship above all: where scarce equipment earns more, and where high utilization has stopped translating into price. Inland tank-barge utilization has sat between 90 and 94 percent across all seven observed quarters from Q1 2024 to Q1 2026; the question for Q2 2026 is whether pricing is still following it up, or whether the rate curve has flattened while boats stayed full.
